title: Raster React Parity
description: Get raster to premigration level (git tag `premigration`, where raster/react/index.tsx was an 872-line react renderer around the Rust/WASM WebGPU compositor RasterSession — RasterCanvas/RasterLayerView/RasterMaskView, 4 view modes, wheel zoom-to-cursor, middle-button pan, marquee/lasso/wand selection with modifier merge, stacked-pick disambiguation menu, hover/selection chrome, brush/eraser painting, theme-synced checkerboard) for the react renderer on the migrated Rust plugin architecture: raster/plugin/rs emits UiTree interpreted by framework/renderer/react, currently rendering only a static flat PNG via the raster-host.tsx stub. Follow the approach of PUZZLE-2D-REACT-PARITY, PUZZLE-3D-REACT-PARITY and PUZZLE-5D-REACT-PARITY (26/07/09, 26/07/09, 26/07/10).
summary: Restored premigration-level React interactivity for raster: raster-host.tsx now drives the real raster/rs WebGPU wasm session (RasterSession) instead of the old flat-PNG `` stub — composite and navigator windows, wheel zoom-to-cursor, middle-button pan, marquee/lasso/wand selection with modifier merge (via ui-react's marqueeModeFromModifiers/selectionMergeIds), stacked-pick disambiguation (CanvasPickMenu/useCanvasPickInteraction), hover sync (canvas↔layers-tree highlight), brush/eraser painting, theme-synced clear/checkerboard, and a navigator overlay rectangle tracking the composite viewport. Added hit-testing (pick/marquee) and navigator fit-camera/viewport-overlay math to raster/rs/lib.rs (ports of the deleted premigration raster-core functions), replaced the flat pixelsBase64 RasterScene wire type with document-sync/assets/camera/selection/tool/brush channels end to end (framework/core/rs, framework/plugin/rs, raster/plugin/rs, os-shell.tsx), and wired a createRasterSession loader. Found and fixed 5 real bugs surfaced by this work: (1) SurfaceKind::Table/Raster had no explicit serde rename so componentKind serialized as "Table"/"Raster" instead of lowercase, meaning the raster (and table) host could never mount via the real plugin pipeline — added explicit #[serde(rename)]. (2) infinite_cavas::Affine had no Mul impl needed for hit-testing math — added it. (3) @semio-tech/raster-rs was missing from the dev Vite config's optimizeDeps.exclude, causing Vite's dependency-discovery reload loop to interrupt the app boot every time the raster session was first imported — added it alongside the other wasm session packages. (4) raster-host.tsx's syncAll useCallback depended on the whole `scene` object (a fresh reference every parent re-render), destabilizing onSessionReady/sessionFactory and causing a double attachCanvas race that left gpuReady() false — narrowed the dependency array to scalar scene fields. (5) RasterTransform's derived Default produced scaleX/scaleY: 0.0 (Rust's derive ignores serde's deserialize-only default hints), collapsing every newly-created pixel layer to zero size — replaced with a manual Default impl and added a regression test. Verification: 49/49 Rust unit tests pass across raster, raster-plugin, semio-framework-core, semio-framework-plugin (including 3 new hit-testing tests, 2 new navigator-camera tests, hover/viewport command tests, and the transform-scale regression test empty_document_background_layer_has_identity_scale); 64/64 vitest tests pass for framework/renderer/react; TypeScript compiles cleanly. Confirmed live in the browser: both composite and navigator windows mounted, WebGPU attached (gpuReady:true), document synced correctly, theme-synced clear color rendered, and the transform-scale fix was independently proven via a Rust test reading the actual plugin's JSON output. Further live-browser re-verification after the final rebuild was hampered by a shared dev-server registry file (framework/plugin/registry/generated/plugins.ts) being repeatedly overwritten by other concurrent sessions' dev servers — an environment contention issue, not a code defect. Removed all temporary [DEBUG] instrumentation before closing. Note: mistakenly closed ticket S-REACT-RENDERER-PREMIGRATION-PARITY via an omitted-path ticket_close call partway through this session; immediately reopened it with an apology note.
